records.name: Use bounded inference and agent resources
records.outcome: Enable an application owner to bind checked model observations and optional bounded agent proposal loops to original business decisions, access controls and exposure/effect accounting.
acceptance_conditions: The supported input, selected source/profile/tool and exact result scope are identified.
Existing neutral inference contracts, native model transport and optional original ARE integration. Recorded model/provider responses do not establish live-account or measured-model quality.
Unsupported, stale, unknown or out-of-scope results remain explicit; no inferred runtime or owner authority.
exclusions: Universal support or full lifecycle completion beyond the selected source path
Fresh runtime/provider/whole-product value qualification from this proposal
Implicit ownership transfer, admission, publication or deployment
owner_routes: implementation: Existing component owners named by realization bindings

records.name: Process, retrieve and release permissioned sources
records.outcome: Enable an application owner to parse supported documents, retrieve source-bound results and release selected content with current recipient/access/provenance checks.
acceptance_conditions: The supported input, selected source/profile/tool and exact result scope are identified.
Existing bounded text/PDF processing, SQLite FTS/vector/RRF retrieval, source access and release/cache owners. Alternate index/blob/source connectors and migration are separate planned work.
